67	    def validate(self, input_str: str, pos: int):
68	        if input_str == "":
69	            return QValidator.State.Intermediate, input_str, pos
70	        if not input_str.isdigit():
71	            return QValidator.State.Invalid, input_str, pos
72	        if len(input_str) > 1 and input_str.startswith("0"):
73	            return QValidator.State.Invalid, input_str, pos
74	        if len(input_str) > 3:
75	            return QValidator.State.Invalid, input_str, pos

723	    def _rebuild_sheet1_strip_cache(self, path: str | None) -> None:
724	        """从首表 Sheet1 解析五个表头词所在行，横向片段写入 _sheet1_strip_arrays 备用。"""
725	        self._sheet1_strip_row = None
726	        for k in SHEET1_SUMMARY_LABELS:
727	            self._sheet1_strip_arrays[k] = []
728	        if not path or not os.path.isfile(path):
729	            return
730	        try:
731	            res = read_sheet1_summary_strip(path)
732	            self._sheet1_strip_row = res.row_1based
733	            for k in SHEET1_SUMMARY_LABELS:
734	                self._sheet1_strip_arrays[k] = list(res.columns.get(k, ()))
735	        except Exception:
736	            traceback.print_exc()
737	
738	    def _apply_payable_total_from_sheet(self, path: str | None) -> None:
739	        """Sheet1 第 4 行「排款总额」右侧数字格求和 → 本月可支付总额。
740	        其余右侧字段归零（本月合计应付总额在智能排款后由界面积分计算）。"""
741	        if not path or not os.path.isfile(path):
742	            return
743	        z = _format_payable_amount(0.0)
744	        try:
745	            total = sum_sheet1_row4_after_payout_through_total_scheduled(path)
746	        except Exception:
747	            traceback.print_exc()
748	            total = None
749	        if total is None:
750	            self.lbl_payable_total_value.setText(z)
751	        else:
752	            self.lbl_payable_total_value.setText(_format_payable_amount(total))
753	        self.lbl_reserved_total_value.setText(z)
754	        self.lbl_strict_payable_value.setText(z)
755	        self.lbl_priority1_payable_value.setText(z)
756	        self.lbl_priority2_payable_value.setText(z)
757	        self.lbl_total_payable_value.setText(z)
758	        self._sync_payable_summary_strip()
759	
760	    def _on_upload_total(self) -> None:
761	        path, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
762	            self, "选择排款计划列表", "", EXCEL_FILTER
763	        )
764	        if not path:
765	            return
766	        if not _is_excel_path(path):
767	            QMessageBox.warning(
768	                self, "格式不支持", "请选择 Excel 文件（.xlsx 或 .xls）。"
769	            )
770	            return
771	        d = total_sheet_dir()
772	        os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
773	        dest = os.path.join(d, os.path.basename(path))
774	        same_file = os.path.normcase(os.path.abspath(path)) == os.path.normcase(
775	            os.path.abspath(dest)
776	        )
777	        replaced = os.path.isfile(dest) and not same_file
778	        try:
779	            # shutil.copy2：目标已有同名文件时直接覆盖
780	            shutil.copy2(path, dest)
781	        except shutil.SameFileError:
782	            pass
783	        except OSError as e:
784	            QMessageBox.critical(self, "上传失败", str(e))
785	            return
786	        self._total_path = dest
787	        msg = f"已保存到：\\n{dest}"
788	        if same_file:
789	            msg = f"所选文件已在目标目录中：\\n{dest}"
790	        elif replaced:
791	            msg += "\\n（已覆盖同名文件。）"
792	        QMessageBox.information(self, "上传成功", msg)
793	        if SHOW_BANK_SETTINGS_CARD:
794	            self._refresh_bank_combo()
795	        else:
796	            self._rebuild_sheet1_strip_cache(dest)
797	        self._apply_payable_total_from_sheet(dest)
798

831	    def _refresh_pay_method_combo(self) -> None:
832	        if not SHOW_BANK_SETTINGS_CARD:
833	            return
834	        self.combo_pay_method.clear()
835	        for s in PAY_METHOD_CHOICES:
836	            self.combo_pay_method.addItem(s)
837	        self.combo_pay_method.setCurrentIndex(0)
838	
839	    def _on_bank_index_changed(self, _index: int) -> None:
840	        if not SHOW_BANK_SETTINGS_CARD:
841	            return
842	        if self._refreshing_bank_combo:
843	            return
844	        if self.combo_pay_method.count() > 0:
845	            self.combo_pay_method.setCurrentIndex(0)
846	        self.edit_amount.clear()
847	
848	    def _refresh_bank_combo(self) -> None:
849	        if not SHOW_BANK_SETTINGS_CARD:
850	            return
851	        self._refreshing_bank_combo = True
852	        try:
853	            self.combo_bank.clear()
854	            self._banks = []
855	            ensure_workspace()
856	            latest = find_latest_total_excel(total_sheet_dir())
857	            self._total_path = latest
858	            if not latest:
859	                self.combo_bank.addItem("（请先上传排款计划总表）")
860	                self.combo_bank.setEnabled(False)
861	                return
862	            self.combo_bank.setEnabled(True)
863	            try:
864	                banks, _fname = read_banks(latest)
865	            except Exception as e:
866	                self.combo_bank.addItem(f"（读取失败：{e}）")
867	                self.combo_bank.setEnabled(False)
868	                QMessageBox.warning(self, "读取总表失败", str(e))
869	                return
870	            self._banks = banks
871	            self.combo_bank.addItem("不限")
872	            for b in banks:
873	                self.combo_bank.addItem(b.display())
874	            self.combo_bank.setCurrentIndex(0)
875	        finally:
876	            self._refreshing_bank_combo = False
877	            self._rebuild_sheet1_strip_cache(self._total_path)
878	
879	    def _current_bank(self) -> BankOption | None:
880	        if not SHOW_BANK_SETTINGS_CARD:
881	            return None
882	        if not self._banks or not self.combo_bank.isEnabled():
883	            return None
884	        if self.combo_bank.count() == 0:
885	            return None
886	        if self.combo_bank.itemText(0) != "不限":
887	            return None
888	        idx = self.combo_bank.currentIndex()
889	        if idx <= 0:
890	            return None
891	        bi = idx - 1
892	        if 0 <= bi < len(self._banks):
893	            return self._banks[bi]
894	        return None
895	
896	    def _on_confirm(self) -> None:
897	        if not SHOW_BANK_SETTINGS_CARD:
898	            return
899	        bank = self._current_bank()
900	        if bank is None:
901	            QMessageBox.warning(
902	                self,
903	                "提示",
904	                "请先上传排款计划总表，并在「银行选择」中选择具体银行（勿选「不限」）。",
905	            )
906	            return
907	        amount_text = self.edit_amount.text().strip()
908	        method = self.combo_pay_method.currentText().strip()
909	        if not amount_text or not method:
910	            QMessageBox.warning(
911	                self,
912	                "校验失败",
913	                "可支付金额 / 付款方式不能为空，请填写完整。",
914	            )
915	            return
916	        try:
917	            amount = float(amount_text.replace(",", ""))
918	        except ValueError:
919	            QMessageBox.warning(self, "校验失败", "可支付金额请输入有效数字。")
920	            return
921	        latest = find_latest_total_excel(total_sheet_dir())
922	        if not latest:
923	            QMessageBox.warning(self, "提示", "未找到排款计划总表文件。")
924	            return
925	        if not latest.lower().endswith(".xlsx"):
926	            QMessageBox.warning(
927	                self,
928	                "格式限制",
929	                "保存银行配置仅支持 .xlsx 格式的排款计划总表。\\n"
930	                "请将总表另存为 Excel 2007+（.xlsx）后重新上传。",
931	            )

1258	def _suppress_macos_imk_stderr_noise() -> None:
1259	    """macOS 上 Qt 与输入法 IMK 会刷 IMKCFRunLoopWakeUpReliable，属系统噪声，过滤以免误判为报错。"""
1260	    if sys.platform != "darwin":
1261	        return
1262	    needle = "IMKCFRunLoopWakeUpReliable"
1263	    real = sys.stderr
1264	
1265	    class _StderrFilter:
1266	        __slots__ = ("_real",)
1267	
1268	        def __init__(self, underlying) -> None:
1269	            self._real = underlying
1270	
1271	        def write(self, s: str) -> int:
1272	            if not s:
1273	                return 0
1274	            if needle not in s:
1275	                self._real.write(s)
1276	                return len(s)
1277	            kept = "".join(
1278	                ln for ln in s.splitlines(keepends=True) if needle not in ln
1279	            )
1280	            if kept:
1281	                self._real.write(kept)
1282	            return len(s)
1283	
1284	        def flush(self) -> None:
1285	            self._real.flush()
1286	
1287	        def __getattr__(self, name: str):
1288	            return getattr(self._real, name)
1289	
1290	    sys.stderr = _StderrFilter(real)  # type: ignore[misc, assignment]
1291

69	def _sheet4_ordered_owner_cost_pairs(
70	    ws: Worksheet, header_row: int, c_owner: int, c_cost: int
71	) -> List[Tuple[str, str]]:
72	    """按表顺序；同一负责人仅保留首次出现。"""
73	    seen: set[str] = set()
74	    out: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
75	    for r in range(header_row + 1, (ws.max_row or 0) + 1):
76	        co = ws.cell(row=r, column=c_owner)
77	        if isinstance(co, MergedCell):
78	            continue
79	        owner = _cell_text_normalized(co.value)
80	        if not owner:
81	            continue
82	        if owner in seen:
83	            continue
84	        seen.add(owner)
85	        cc = ws.cell(row=r, column=c_cost)
86	        cost_nm = ""
87	        if not isinstance(cc, MergedCell):
88	            cost_nm = _cell_text_normalized(cc.value)
89	        out.append((owner, cost_nm))
90	    return out
91	
92	
93	def _find_sheet1_owner_col(ws: Worksheet, header_row: int) -> Optional[int]:
94	    """优先「负责人」，否则「主体」（表头可带中英文冒号）。"""
95	    max_c = ws.max_column or 0
96	    for want in ("负责人", "主体"):
97	        for c in range(1, max_c + 1):
98	            cell = ws.cell(row=header_row, column=c)
99	            if isinstance(cell, MergedCell):
100	                continue
101	            t = _norm_header_label(_cell_text_normalized(cell.value))
102	            if t == want:
103	                return c
104	    return None
105

107	def load_owner_cost_panel_stats(path: str) -> Optional[OwnerCostPanelStats]:
108	    """
109	    读取总表：Sheet4 定顺序与成本名称；Sheet1 按负责人汇总付款计划列。
110	    非 .xlsx、缺表/缺列时返回 None。
111	    """
112	    if _is_xls(path):
113	        return None
114	    wb = load_workbook(path, read_only=False, data_only=True)
115	    try:
116	        if len(wb.worksheets) < 4:
117	            return None
118	        ws4 = wb.worksheets[3]
119	        h4 = _find_sheet4_header_cols(ws4)
120	        if h4 is None:
121	            return None
122	        hr4, c4o, c4c = h4
123	        pairs = _sheet4_ordered_owner_cost_pairs(ws4, hr4, c4o, c4c)
124	        if not pairs:
125	            return None
126	
127	        ws1 = wb.worksheets[0]
128	        hr1 = _find_sheet1_header_row(ws1)
129	        if hr1 is None:
130	            return None
131	        c_owner = _find_sheet1_owner_col(ws1, hr1)
132	        if c_owner is None:
133	            return None
134	        c_pri = _find_col_header_contains(ws1, hr1, "付款优先级")
135	        if c_pri is None:
136	            return None
137	        c_plan = _find_payment_plan_col(ws1, hr1)
138	        if c_plan is None:
139	            return None
140	
141	        sum_zero: Dict[str, float] = {}
142	        sum_p1: Dict[str, float] = {}
143	        sum_p2: Dict[str, float] = {}
144	        sum_all: Dict[str, float] = {}
145	        max_r1 = ws1.max_row or 0
146	        for r in range(hr1 + 1, max_r1 + 1):
147	            cell_o = ws1.cell(row=r, column=c_owner)
148	            if isinstance(cell_o, MergedCell):
149	                continue
150	            owner = _cell_text_normalized(cell_o.value)
151	            if not owner:
152	                continue
153	            cell_p = ws1.cell(row=r, column=c_plan)
154	            if isinstance(cell_p, MergedCell):
155	                continue
156	            n = _coerce_numeric_for_sum(cell_p.value)
157	            amt = float(n) if n is not None else 0.0
158	            sum_all[owner] = sum_all.get(owner, 0.0) + amt
159	            pl = _priority_level_0_2(ws1.cell(row=r, column=c_pri).value)
160	            if pl == 0:
161	                sum_zero[owner] = sum_zero.get(owner, 0.0) + amt
162	            elif pl == 1:
163	                sum_p1[owner] = sum_p1.get(owner, 0.0) + amt
164	            elif pl == 2:
165	                sum_p2[owner] = sum_p2.get(owner, 0.0) + amt
166	
167	        cost_labels: List[str] = []
168	        zero_list: List[float] = []
169	        p1_list: List[float] = []
170	        p2_list: List[float] = []
171	        all_list: List[float] = []
172	        for owner, cost_nm in pairs:
173	            label = cost_nm if cost_nm else owner
174	            cost_labels.append(label)
175	            zero_list.append(sum_zero.get(owner, 0.0))
176	            p1_list.append(sum_p1.get(owner, 0.0))
177	            p2_list.append(sum_p2.get(owner, 0.0))
178	            all_list.append(sum_all.get(owner, 0.0))
179	
180	        return OwnerCostPanelStats(
181	            cost_labels=tuple(cost_labels),
182	            per_owner_zero=tuple(zero_list),
183	            per_owner_priority1=tuple(p1_list),
184	            per_owner_priority2=tuple(p2_list),
185	            per_owner_all=tuple(all_list),
186	            sum_zero=sum(zero_list),
187	            sum_priority1=sum(p1_list),
188	            sum_priority2=sum(p2_list),
189	            sum_all=sum(all_list),
190	        )
191	    finally:
